index e1f257c..ba4929e 100644
--- a/fixtures/next-app/lib/posts.ts
+++ b/fixtures/next-app/lib/posts.ts
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@ const seed = [
   ['bundle-size-is-a-proxy', 'Bundle size is a proxy', 'It proves something changed, not that it got slower.', 5],
 ] as const
 
-export const posts: Post[] = seed.map(([slug, title, excerpt, readingMinutes], i) =>
+const handWritten: Post[] = seed.map(([slug, title, excerpt, readingMinutes], i) =>
   postSchema.parse({
     slug,
     title,
@@ -28,6 +28,19 @@ export const posts: Post[] = seed.map(([slug, title, excerpt, readingMinutes], i
   }),
 )
 
+// The archive import: 300 generated posts, each its own statically generated page.
+const archive: Post[] = Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) =>
+  postSchema.parse({
+    slug: `archive-post-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
+    title: `Archive post ${i + 1}`,
+    excerpt: `Retrospective measurement notes, entry ${i + 1} of the imported archive.`,
+    publishedAt: format(subDays(new Date('2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'), i), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
+    readingMinutes: (i % 11) + 2,
+  }),
+)
+
+export const posts: Post[] = [...handWritten, ...archive]
+
 export function getPost(slug: string): Post | undefined {
   return posts.find((p) => p.slug === slug)
 }
